objective: Establish the deterministic provider-neutral technical feature and indicator foundation for P08, including point-in-time OHLCV validation, indicator identity, common evidence contracts and explicit independence-group metadata without creating trade authority.
scope: Define governed technical-intelligence foundation policy and supported technical evidence families
Validate deterministic point-in-time OHLCV bar inputs with trusted-data lineage
Define a common family-level technical evidence object with direction, strength, freshness, timeframe, confidence and invalidation metadata
Require explicit independence-group metadata so correlated transforms cannot masquerade as independent confirmations
Provide deterministic reference SMA and rate-of-change primitives for foundation certification
Provide independent-confirmation counting by unique independence group without producing trade decisions
Activate P08 and reconcile task/lock state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Market Structure and Price Action models (P08-D)
Signal fusion, probability calibration, risk approval, broker/exchange execution or order placement
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P08 source
Valid point-in-time OHLCV bars pass deterministically
Invalid OHLC relationships and negative volume fail closed
Future-looking event time relative to as-of time fails closed
Indicator definition identity is deterministic and content-sensitive
Evidence strength and confidence are bounded in integer basis points
Technical evidence carries source dataset and quality lineage
Evidence identity is deterministic and content-sensitive
Multiple evidence objects in the same independence group count as one confirmation
Reference SMA and rate-of-change primitives are deterministic
No technical evidence object contains trade/order authority
P08-A evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No credential or network access is required
No production technical-intelligence vendor is selected
rollback: Revert P08-A foundation module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and P08 active-state reconciliation. P07/G5 remain canonical and no production/trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Point-in-time and trusted-lineage invariants fail closed
Common technical evidence contract established without trade authority
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
